metadata.author: Griptape, Inc.
metadata.description: Neural-network-based green/blue screen keying tool by Niko Pueringer / Corridor Digital. Takes an RGB frame plus a coarse alpha hint and outputs a clean straight alpha matte, a despilled foreground, and an optional checkerboard composite preview. Distributed as green-screen and blue-screen GreenFormer (Hiera + refiner) checkpoints with auto-download from HuggingFace.

corridorkey.title: CorridorKey
corridorkey.description: Neural network green/blue screen keying and alpha-hint generation

metadata.description: Runs the full CorridorKey neural keying pipeline on a single image frame. Takes an RGB image and an optional coarse alpha-hint mask; if no hint is supplied, BiRefNet is used internally to generate one. Produces a clean straight alpha matte, a despilled sRGB foreground, a linear premultiplied RGBA composite, and an optional composite-on-checkerboard preview. Supports both green-screen and blue-screen checkpoints with auto-download from HuggingFace.
